title: Come Thou Fount of
lyrics_original: Come, Thou Fount of every blessing,
Tune my heart to sing Thy grace;
Streams of mercy, never ceasing,
Call for songs of loudest praise.
Teach me some melodious sonnet,
Sung by flaming tongues above.
Praise the mount! I’m fixed upon it,
Mount of Thy redeeming love.
Here I raise my Ebenezer;
Here by Thy great help I’ve come;
And I hope, by Thy good pleasure,
Safely to arrive at home.
Jesus sought me when a stranger,
Wandering from the fold of God;
He, to rescue me from danger,
Interposed His precious blood;
O to grace how great a debtor
Daily I’m constrained to be!
Let Thy goodness, like a fetter,
Bind my wandering heart to Thee.
Prone to wander, Lord, I feel it,
Prone to leave the God I love;
Here’s my heart, O take and seal it,
Seal it for Thy courts above.
O that day when freed from sinning,
I shall see Thy lovely face;
Clothed then in blood washed linen
How I’ll sing Thy sovereign grace;
Come, my Lord, no longer tarry,
Take my ransomed soul away;
Send thine angels now to carry
Me to realms of endless day.

bible_verses.telugu: అప్పుడు సమూయేలు ఒక రాయి తీసి మిస్పాకును షేనుకును మధ్య దానిని నిలిపియింతవరకు యెహోవా మనకు సహాయము చేసెనని చెప్పి దానికి ఎబెనెజరు1 అను పేరు పెట్టెను.
bible_verses.english: Then Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Shen. He named it Ebenezer, saying, 'Thus far the Lord has helped us.'

bible_verses.telugu: శ్రేష్ఠమైన ప్రతియీవియు సంపూర్ణమైన ప్రతి వరమును, పరసంబంధమైనదై, జ్యోతిర్మయుడగు తండ్రియొద్దనుండి వచ్చును; ఆయనయందు ఏ చంచలత్వమైనను గమనాగమనములవలన కలుగు ఏ ఛాయయైనను లేదు.
bible_verses.english: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, who does not change like shifting shadows.

bible_verses.telugu: నా ప్రాణమా, యెహోవాను సన్నుతించుము ఆయన చేసిన ఉపకారములలో దేనిని మరువకుము
bible_verses.english: Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all his benefits.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, You are the faithful source of every blessing in my life. Thank You for Your endless streams of mercy that carry me through every season. When my heart wanders, gently tune my spirit back to the melody of Your redeeming love. Help me to remember how far You have brought me, and anchor my hope securely in Your goodness today. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Every good gift flows from God’s unfailing grace, like a river that never runs dry. When we pause to raise our own "Ebenezer"—a landmark of remembrance—we recall just how far His faithful hand has brought us. Our prone-to-wander hearts constantly need His gentle tuning to stay aligned with His love. Today, let His relentless mercy fill your spirit and tune your heart to sing His glorious praise.
